settings.seo_text_1:
The grandad collar loses the collar stand and the buttons at the neck, which takes the formality out of a shirt without taking the shape out of it. Left open it sits flat and clean instead of splaying, so it reads considered rather than undone.

Same body as the signature shirt underneath: fitted through the chest and taken in at the waist.
